notes:
Automated portion only. The steps of CLEAN_MACHINE_TEST.md that need a person - 5-7, 13-24, 27, 32 and 35 - were NOT performed and are listed under "Not performed" below. Chief among them is an end-to-end run on the installed build: recognition, Excel reporting and the parallel worker path are covered by 4162 automated tests, but every one of those runs from source, not from the installer.

To complete them: run packaging\sandbox\New-SandboxPayload.ps1 -Launch -Wait, work through the interface in the sandbox window it leaves open, then run Complete-ManualChecks.ps1 from the payload folder and regenerate this report.

Also run against this same artifact, on the build machine: the full suite (4162 passed, 2 skipped), Test-PackagedApp.ps1 (16/16), Test-InstallerRoundTrip.ps1 (15/15), Test-SelfContained.ps1 (14/14, including an installation under a path with spaces and non-ASCII characters), audit_dependencies.py (0 unresolved imports) and Invoke-ReleaseVerification.ps1 (14/14).
